reference.warning: HEAD is a verifiable repository reference, not an isolated pre-refactor baseline. Working tree includes earlier user changes and multiple refactor batches.

methodology.physicalLines: Number of CRLF/CR/LF-delimited physical rows; no extra empty row for a terminal newline; comments included.
methodology.nonBlankLines: Physical rows containing at least one non-whitespace character; comments included; not logical SLOC.

groups.platform-backend: C/src minus UI; includes contracts, fixtures and testing helpers kept under src.
groups.platform-ui: C/src/app/public plus C/src/ui/src and C/src/ui/index.html; generated workbench excluded.
groups.platform-tests: C/tests plus C/src/ui/tests, including authored fixtures/helpers.
groups.kernel-tests: C/vendor/coding-agent/tests, including authored fixtures/helpers, excluding bundled vendor dependencies.

methodology.workingTree: Filesystem inventory, including untracked source; symlinks not followed. No source writes.
methodology.exclusions: Docs, evidence, dependency/vendor subdirectories, build/dist/coverage/cache/results, recognized generated filenames, non-code extensions and UI build configuration. Source declarations remain included; JSON/YAML/manifests/locks are not source code in this metric.
methodology.functionKinds: Declarations/expressions/arrows/methods/constructors/getters/setters with a body, including callbacks. Signatures without bodies excluded.
methodology.branchComplexity: 1 per function + if + for/for-in/for-of/while/do + non-default case + catch + ternary + &&/||/??. Nested functions scored separately, not in parent; parameter initializers included. Optional chaining, else/default, implicit exception paths and top-level branches are not counted.
methodology.functionLength: Inclusive source start/end line span, excluding leading comments and including nested function spans; arrow expressions included. Lengths overlap and must not be summed as LOC.
methodology.percentiles: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(n * p) - 1]. Means rounded to 3 decimals.
methodology.limitations: Syntactic branch approximation, not formal CFG cyclomatic complexity, algorithmic Big-O, cognitive complexity, runtime work, latency or readability. TypeScript parser only; no HTML-embedded JS, CSS, Python or SQL AST. Parse-error files retain LOC but are excluded from function metrics.

moduleMap.note: Declared current ownership and allowed edges; edge count is not a scan of imports or observed runtime dependencies. Transitional injected readers are reported separately and prevent claiming target DAG convergence.
